items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 22 at 2:58AM CST until November 22 at 9:00AM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Montgomery; Colorado; Austin; Waller; Inland Harris; Chambers; Wharton; Fort Bend; Inland Jackson; Inland Matagorda; Inland Brazoria; Inland Galveston; Southern Liberty; Coastal Harris; Coastal Jackson; Coastal Matagorda; Coastal Brazoria; Coastal Galveston; Brazoria Islands; Galveston Island; Boliv
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Portions of south central and southeast Texas.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM CST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility could make driving conditions hazardous.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Areas of fog will reduce visibility to below
one quarter mile at times within the advisory area.
items.instruction:
If driving, slow down, use your headlights, and leave plenty of
distance ahead of you.

items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 21 at 10:46PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
Areas of fog with visibility of 2 NM or less will be possible
over the Galveston Bay, with the lowest visibility across the
upper part of the Bay, including the Houston Ship Channel through
early Sunday morning. Mariners should be prepared for abrupt
visibility changes down to 1 NM or less. A Dense Fog Advisory
may be needed if visibility drops to and remains at or below 1 NM.


Mariners should exercise caution, reduce speeds, and be prepared
for sudden drops in visibility.

items.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 22 at 2:32AM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Matagorda Bay; Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from Freeport to Matagorda Ship Channel TX out 20 NM; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM
items.description:
Patchy dense fog is expected to impact portions of the Upper Texas
Coast into the morning hours on Sunday. Localized shutout
conditions have been observed. A Marine Dense Fog advisory will
be warranted if fog can manage to become more widespread. Fog has
remained patchy thus far. But trends will monitored closely.

items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 22 at 3:05AM CST until November 22 at 9:00AM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM
items.description:
* WHAT...Dense fog will reduce visibility to 1 NM or less.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay and the adjacent nearshore Gulf waters

* WHEN...Until 9 AM CST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Low visibility will make navigation difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Visibility will likely fluctuate as areas
of fog impact Galveston Bay and the nearby Gulf waters this
morning.
items.instruction:
If you must navigate, proceed with caution. Use proper fog
signals. Make sure all running lights are on. Remember to use
your radar and compass.
